rules.title: Housing Stability Notification Act (HSNA)
rules.requirement: Landlords and foreclosing owners in Boston must give tenants a Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources at the same time they serve a Notice to Quit or a Notice of Non-renewal of lease, and must send a copy of that notice along with a Certificate of Compliance/Service to the City's Office of Housing Stability.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to all landlords/foreclosing owners intending to end a tenancy or post-foreclosure occupancy of a unit in the City of Boston.
rules.exemptions: Residences in any hospital, skilled nursing facility or health facility; and residences in a non-profit facility whose primary purpose is providing short-term treatment, assistance or therapy for alcohol, drug, or other substance abuse.
rules.citation: Boston Ordinance, Housing Stability Notification Act, Sec. 10-11.7
rules.quoted_span:
The Ordinance applies to all landlords/foreclosing owners intending to end a
tenancy or post-foreclosure occupancy of a unit in the City of Boston.

coverage.other_unknown_factor: whether the property is a hospital, skilled nursing facility, health facility, or a non-profit facility primarily providing short-term substance abuse treatment
